answer_1.quote: Large language models (LLMs) are large-scale deep learning models that can understand and generate natural languages by learning from a large amount of textual data.
answer_1.outputs: The paper generates news-like text and code from LLMs using watermarking methods such as STA-1 and STA-M.

answer_2.quote: For text quality, we measured perplexity (PPL) and coherence for generations on C4; We computed PPL and pass@k scores of code generations for HumanEval.
